policy: backtest numbers never appear on the live leaderboard - this file IS the backtest table and is labelled as such everywhere it is rendered
rank is by benchmark-relative Brier skill with a weekly-cluster lower bound and a Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across all trials in this workspace
win rate and ROI are published but never used to rank
control baselines run on every build so skill can be separated from luck
_meta.scored_sample_warning: n=104 out-of-sample games; the pre-registered floor for any qualification is 300, so ZERO strategies can qualify at this sample regardless of their scores

staking_table.why_not_ranked: a staking run at an assumed price cannot distinguish skill from a lucky streak, and no verified price exists to compute CLV or real ROI. This table is published to show the number, not to rank it.

luck_panel.reading: the model's hit count is INSIDE the range that its own probabilities produce by chance; not evidence of skill

_meta.rule: a strategy returns from LIVE to PAPER automatically when ANY condition below fires; no human discretion, no averaging of conditions
_meta.note: nothing is LIVE, so the gate is evaluated on zero strategies. The gate is still published and machine-checked so it cannot be waived later.

conditions.condition: rolling-20-game cluster lower bound of Brier skill <= 0
conditions.why: a live strategy that stops beating climatology is a demoted strategy
miscalibration destroys stake sizing before it destroys the average

conditions.condition: any input feed stale beyond 24h at kickoff
conditions.why: a correct model on stale availability is a wrong model

conditions.condition: realised ROI below the lower edge of the pre-registered interval
conditions.why: published so a bad staking run cannot be called variance forever

demotion_gate.why_not_evaluable: no strategy holds LIVE status, and no verified price exists for D4

reward_policy: reward units are escrowed until a strategy clears G1-G4 AND holds LIVE status. 0 of 1000 awarded.
